title: Turkish Dative Case (-a / -e)
summary: Expressing 'to' or direction towards a location.
explanation: Adds '-a/-e' according to vowel harmony. If word ends in a vowel, insert buffer 'y' (e.g. eve, okula, sinemaya).

example_translations.ex_trdat_1: I am going home / to the house.

common_error_explanations.err_trdat_1: Use '-e' for words with front vowels.
